scope: Source worktree and actual Linux tests only. No installed bundle, Android device, GPU pixel parity, persisted 3D project service or arbitrary-tool sandbox acceptance.

api.readScene3DInput: Strict UTF8 exact content and hash plus native plan/parsed model-sourceLocations; no filesystem mutation
api.exportScene3DProject: Only a fresh absent output directory; returned manifest and private session receipt
api.executeScene3DProject: Explicit absolute executable; one branded fresh receipt permits identify/import/script-check and optional finite probe
api.cli: --input source default plan; --emit model gives actual model; --output absent directory; optional --check OR --run with --godot-bin absolute
api.backend: org.viento.godot4 majorVersion4 prototype=true; independent of existing 2D registry/protocol
api.coordinates: Right-handed Y-up -Z-forward EulerXYZ T*Rx*Ry*Rz*S; explicit rotation_order0

verification.copiedGeneratedEvidence: godot-final/<case>/ all five inventory files plus manifest exact SHA
verification.peerReadOnlyReview: Core owner independently reviewed standalone host/runtime; no further concrete ownership/source-loss finding (team message). Full-app and prepared tests are owned and separately recorded by root.

closedFindings.finding: CLI --emit model originally returned parser envelope
closedFindings.fix: Return native actual model; 13-test initial 12/1 preserved in export-tests-initial.log

closedFindings.finding: Direct norm loses robust direction at subnormal values
closedFindings.fix: Scale before temporary normalization; author source/plan values remain exact

closedFindings.finding: Godot look_at followed by position update loses near-Y-up horizontal component via float32 Euler decomposition
closedFindings.fix: Assign complete Transform3D with Basis.looking_at; actual high-position and near-vertical probe passes

closedFindings.finding: Godot JSON parse/display underflows tiny authored directions or rotations
closedFindings.fix: Runtime uses validated generated normalized direction metadata; host independently recomputes original vectors and basis, probe numeric declarations use bounded1e-12 tolerance; exact stored source/plan remain unchanged

retainedAttempts.reason: Real CLI model envelope contract mismatch repaired only NEW CLI.
NEW near-vertical camera fixture sat at f64 .01/1e-4 boundary and correctly failed native admission; fixture given numeric margin.
Actual Godot float32 Euler basis reconstruction and JSON subnormal parsing exposed NEW runtime issues; minimal standalone runtime repair.
Successful intermediate proof before root-requested tiny-rotation receipt tolerance refinement; final18 after refinement separately retained.

limitations: Explicit authorized absolute tool is trusted; vendor authenticity not inferred from version string.
No security sandbox against arbitrary same-UID concurrent changes after last path/inode/SHA check.
Godot-generated cache roots retained after successful execution; source manifest inventories five immutable generated/input files and excludes later cache.
Execution receipt is not serializable transferable or reusable; persisted output can be inspected but this prototype CLI does not adopt it for execution.
Positions/materials/bases reported with documented bounded float32 tolerances; stored source bytes remain exact.
